Title: SWE Infrastructure Specialist (JS/TS/Python) – Freelance AI Trainer Project

Clear technical communication and the ability to clearly articulate system-level reasoning and tradeoffs are essential. Ready to turn your engineering expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world. We offer a pay range of $80-to-$150 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.
